read-symbols assumption: Requirement IDs are unique across the five semantic reads slices, which replace CAP-SEMANTIC-READS. A reference to a requirement outside this spec names the slice that owns it: read-domain SR-001, SR-002, SR-012, SR-014, SR-021, SR-022, SR-023, SR-024; read-pipeline SR-003, SR-004, SR-005, SR-015, SR-016, SR-019, SR-020, SR-026, SR-028; read-text-search SR-010, SR-017; read-symbols SR-006, SR-007, SR-008, SR-011, SR-013, SR-018, SR-025; read-references SR-009, SR-027.

read-symbols assumption: IntelliJ JUnit 5 test fixtures for a Java project with editors, libraries, generated and excluded roots, dumb mode and a test reference query executor are available through the IntelliJ Platform Gradle test framework configuration; the design may change plugin-core/build.gradle.kts for this and must keep tests discoverable as @Test methods.

read-symbols assumption: Smart pointers return no element after the element is deleted. After the element's text is replaced, restore by element info can bind to a replacement declaration at the same range (SmartPsiElementPointerImpl.java:90-115), so SR-013 compares the restored kind, name and signature with the handle payload.
read-symbols assumption: The Structure View builder is not relied on for outlines because background use is not established; outlines walk Java PSI declarations in a background read action.

read-symbols assumption: Normalizations of product terms: SR-025 range, signature, owner and containing-declaration definitions; SR-006 catalog declaration kinds; SR-003 line model and defaults; SR-004 path rendering and check order; SR-010 match and excerpt rule and skipped-file count; SR-020 READ_FAILED category rule; SR-026 failure precedence; SR-001 query validation; SR-004 canonical root comparison; SR-009 reference range, line and kind; SR-010 document offsets and match column; SR-025 parameter type text, array dimensions and compact constructors; SR-012 entry kinds.

read-symbols assumption: Normalizations of scope: generated sources are omitted from find_file, unrestricted search_symbols and search_text directory scans, and included and marked in find_references so reference sets stay complete; handle reuse for the same element (SR-011) keeps one live handle per element in the registry.

read-symbols assumption: Java short-name stub lookups hide library source files unless library sources are included (JavaSourceFilterScope.java:36-51). A project reference to a compiled library class or method is equivalent to the declaration in its attached source (PsiClassImplUtil.java:1162-1228,1251-1273), so find_references on a library source handle finds project references.
